module_usage_note: Module IDs are internal routing metadata. A03 and A10 describe the scoped implementation connection; B01 is a recommendation for subsequent work, not work claimed as completed.

evidence.metric_definition: Scheduled consultations divided by qualified inbound inquiries matching the advertised service list; spam, blanks and duplicates excluded.
limitations: Seasonality, staffing, other channels and unpaid media could also affect consultation volume.
Comparison does not isolate each intervention.
No recorded reply within two hours does not establish whether a reply was late, absent or unrecorded.
evidence.proposed_next_step: Review inquiries without a recorded reply within two hours and check team handoffs.

video.source: same eight slides; reflow text instead of cropping

article.title: Three ways to inquire. One clear next step.
article.subtitle: A med spa simplified its consultation request and assigned responsibility for the first reply. The recorded consultation booking rate moved from about 18% to 27%.

slides.title:

slides.body: A clearer route to a consultation.
slides.speaker_notes: Three ways to inquire. One clear next step.

slides.title: Three competing starts.
slides.speaker_notes: One med spa offered a consultation, skin analysis and a phone number.

slides.title: The handoff was unclear.

slides.speaker_notes: The public route also lacked a named response owner.

slides.title: One request. One owner.

One consultation request.
A two-hour response rule.
slides.speaker_notes: The change: one consultation request, with a two-hour reply rule.

slides.title: A shared responsibility.
slides.speaker_notes: CAESTHETIC defined the route and measurement. The practice owned responses.

56% had a recorded reply within two hours.
Next: investigate the remaining inquiries.

captions.instagram:
A consultation, an online skin analysis and a phone number: one med spa offered three separate starts. The public route did not identify a response owner.

The change combined one consultation request, a named owner and a two-hour first-response rule. Media spend stayed unchanged.

Consultation bookings / qualified inquiries moved from 36/201 (18%) to 59/220 (27%). Periods: 6 Jan–5 Apr and 5 May–2 Aug 2025. Rates are rounded; there was no holdout group.

Recorded replies within two hours reached 56%. Reviewing the remaining inquiries is a proposed next step.

captions.instagram:
Who owns the next inquiry?

In this med spa case, the public inquiry route did not name a response owner. The work paired one consultation request with a named owner and a two-hour first-response rule.

CAESTHETIC defined the route, response rule and measurement. The practice owned the replies.

Recorded first human replies within two hours moved from 54/201 (27%) to 123/220 (56%) qualified inquiries. Periods: 6 Jan–5 Apr and 5 May–2 Aug 2025; rates rounded.

The remaining inquiries need review: the metric does not tell us whether replies were late, absent or unrecorded.
